title: openai/symphony — Symphony turns project work into isolated, autonomous implementations
one_liner: OpenAI's SPEC-first autonomous-implementation orchestrator daemon: Linear-driven polling, per-issue persistent workspace isolation, stateless tracker-as-truth, Codex app-server protocol over stdio.

key_discoveries.title: SPEC.md as product
key_discoveries.summary: OpenAI ships Symphony primarily as a formal specification rather than a binary. The recommended install path is 'point your coding agent at SPEC.md and have it build Symphony for your stack.' An Elixir reference implementation exists for behavior clarification. This makes Symphony a protocol/contract more than a runtime.

key_discoveries.title: Run attempt phase enum
key_discoveries.summary: PreparingWorkspace → BuildingPrompt → LaunchingAgentProcess → InitializingSession → StreamingTurn → Finishing → {Succeeded | Failed | TimedOut | Stalled | CanceledByReconciliation}. A formal state machine for worker lifecycle.

key_discoveries.title: Persistent per-issue filesystem workspaces (NOT git worktrees)
key_discoveries.summary: Symphony isolates via <workspace.root>/<sanitized_identifier> directories that persist across attempts. Deliberate choice: warm context across retries beats cold-start parallelism. Enforces three safety invariants: subprocess cwd = workspace, path containment under root, sanitized names [A-Za-z0-9._-]. No container or VM isolation mandated — explicit refusal to prescribe trust posture.

key_discoveries.title: Stateless orchestrator — no persistent database
key_discoveries.summary: All dispatch state lives in-memory (running map, claimed set, retry_attempts, completed, codex_totals, rate_limits). On restart: startup terminal-workspace cleanup, fresh poll of active issues, re-dispatch. Tracker (Linear) IS the source of truth. Recovery is one poll cycle.
key_discoveries.implication: Drop _bmad/orchestrator-tmux-state.json as authority; treat as cache over gh issue list

key_discoveries.title: WORKFLOW.md governance with hot reload
key_discoveries.summary: Single file: YAML front matter (tracker, polling, workspace, hooks, agent, codex) + Markdown body (prompt template). Watched at runtime; any change hot-reloads config without restart. Invalid reload → keeps last known-good + operator error. Defensive re-validation before each dispatch cycle defeats watch misses. Strict template engine — unknown variables/filters FAIL.

key_discoveries.title: Reconcile-before-dispatch polling tick
key_discoveries.summary: Every polling.interval_ms (default 30000): (1) reconcile active runs including stall detection and tracker state refresh, (2) validate dispatch config, (3) fetch candidates in active_states, (4) sort by priority → creation_time, (5) dispatch while slots available. Reconcile BEFORE dispatch — our current loop dispatches first.

key_discoveries.title: JSON-RPC-like app-server protocol over subprocess stdio
key_discoveries.summary: Agent integration via stdio JSON-RPC: initialize → initialized → thread/start (approval, sandbox, workspace) → turn/start (rendered prompt or continuation). Continuation turns reuse same thread/workspace within one worker lifetime. agent.max_turns default 20. Worker re-checks tracker state between turns. Unsupported dynamic tool calls rejected without stalling. User-input requests HARD-FAIL the attempt.
related: Code Mode (Sunil Pai) sandboxed code execution

key_discoveries.title: session_id = thread_id + '-' + turn_id
key_discoveries.summary: Live session metadata keyed on (thread_id, turn_id). Tracks codex_app_server_pid, last_codex_event, last_codex_timestamp, token counters, turn_count. Per-attempt granularity in session registry.

key_discoveries.title: Exponential retry backoff with ceiling
key_discoveries.summary: Continuation retries after normal exit: 1000 ms fixed. Failure-driven retries: min(10000 * 2^(attempt-1), agent.max_retry_backoff_ms). If retry timer fires but issue no longer in active states → release claim.

key_discoveries.title: Per-state concurrency caps
key_discoveries.summary: Global: available_slots = max(max_concurrent_agents - running_count, 0). Plus agent.max_concurrent_agents_by_state[state] (lowercase normalized) per-state caps. Optional worker.max_concurrent_agents_per_host SSH cap shared across hosts.

key_discoveries.title: Agent-owned ticket mutations via linear_graphql tool
key_discoveries.summary: Symphony does NOT mutate tickets itself. Exposes optional client-side linear_graphql tool so the agent, not the orchestrator, posts comments, moves states, attaches PRs. One operation per call, rejects multi-op docs, returns structured success/failure with raw GraphQL response preserved.
key_discoveries.our_equivalent: gh issue comment / gh issue edit as agent tools

key_discoveries.title: 5 issue orchestration states
key_discoveries.summary: Unclaimed → Claimed (Running | RetryQueued) → Running → RetryQueued → Released. Issue-level state distinct from run-attempt phase enum.

key_discoveries.title: Workspace path-containment check
key_discoveries.summary: Before subprocess launch, assert realpath(cwd).startswith(realpath(workspace_root)). Defeats ..-breakout in unrestricted permission modes. Fits as PreToolUse hook.

key_discoveries.title: Optional HTTP observability at /api/v1
key_discoveries.summary: Loopback-bound HTTP server: GET /api/v1/state (running, retrying, aggregates), GET /api/v1/<issue_identifier> (detail), POST /api/v1/refresh (trigger poll). Dashboard at /. CLI --port overrides WORKFLOW.md server.port.
